the discount rate of public projects should be higher than the discount rates applied in private projects, and the discount rate applied in public projects should not be constant in time and space.
the EU project evaluation system is not suitable for public projects, because the discount rate used in it is not appropriate.

the question of whether the current EU evaluation system is able to identify and select the best public projects.
the question of the application of the discount rate in the evaluation of public projects.
the question of how the social discount rate should be calculated in the case of public projects, which are not subject to market forces.
